title: The whole route in one line
summary: Reservoir prologue, lost duel, Dilapidated Temple, Outskirts, Hirata memory, Ashina Castle, then four regions in a free order (Senpou, Sunken Valley, Ashina Depths, Mibu) that feed the castle invasion, Fountainhead and the Reservoir finale. Shura ends the game early at the castle; the other three endings share Fountainhead, the Divine Dragon and the Sword Saint.
values: main boss defeat flags 9300-9318; castle invasion 8301 (Mortal Blade 2400 + Lotus 2500 + Shelter Stone 2501); Divine Dragon down 8302; ending flags 6830-6833
how: common.emevd events 300 (boss rewards), 820/830 (story clock), 910-912/920 (world stages), 901 (first time boss); per-map boss events

needs.why: the world-stage flags this route flips

check: Open docs/kb/game-flow.md and follow the numbered steps; each has its flag and idol to look for.
note: Order follows the all-bosses recording and the Fextralife walkthrough. The four region steps (23 to 34) can be done in other orders in the real game; the data only forces the gates named in each step.
